evidence.summary: SASTIND and the Ministry of Education named Southeast University in 2016 as a university they co-build for 2016–2020.
SEU says it has obtained the complete set of defence research qualifications: secrecy, quality, production licence and contractor qualification.
The same set of qualifications includes a production licence (生产许可) for its defence research.
It reports that its defence research funding passed 100 million yuan during 2011–2015 and reached 180 million yuan in 2015, among the highest of the Ministry of Education’s universities.
